text: Will the PCB be mounted horizontally or vertically?

speaker: freelancer
text: Because the orientation affects the connector layout, I need to know which mounting option we are using.

speaker: client
text: In that case, let us mount it vertically.

speaker: client
text: Choose the orientation that produces the cleanest connector layout, and I will adapt the case to your board.

speaker: freelancer
text: Would placing the connectors along these three sides of the board be possible?

speaker: client
text:
Regardless of orientation, these are the constraints I can identify:

\- Because the battery sits alongside the PCB, J\_BAT must be on a short edge
\- The user-facing USB-C must also be on a short edge
\- J\_DISP\_SPI / J\_DISP\_I2C / J\_DISP\_LED must be grouped on the edge nearest the display-flex route
\- The antenna end of the ESP32-S3 must face away from the battery and have a ≥8mm keepout

speaker: client
text: Yes, I think that should be possible. With only one board plus sensors, buttons, and LEDs that are all easy to position, I do not expect an issue wherever you place the connectors.
